messages:
faye: quick design sketch: split the onboarding flow into 3 pluggable steps — preflight (fast sanity), micro-bench (3-6m adaptive checks), and deep-bench (full regressions). want to nail interface boundaries before we touch adapter-v2 removal.

omar: +1. can we make the interfaces smaller and idempotent? e.g., preflight returns a tiny decision enum and a short opaque token that micro-bench can fetch with. keeps retry simple.

leah: love the token idea. contract proposal: Preflight -> {decision, admit_token, hints}. Micro-bench consumes admit_token -> {decision, reasons[], metrics_url}. Deep-bench runs off metrics_url snapshot. Keep JSON payloads <= 4KB.

faye: exactly. also propose decision values: ALLOW, PROBATION, REJECT. ALLOW=fast-pass, PROBATION=soft-warn route to canary, REJECT=quarantine.

omar: sampling: micro-bench should be adaptive — pick more rare-edge cases when artifact metadata indicates wide-token model (e.g., multilingual flagged). otherwise tighten sample to reduce cost.

leah: runtime surfaces: prefer HTTP/gRPC with a stable header for gateway routing: X-Admit-Decision: ALLOW|PROBATION|REJECT and X-Admit-Token for async fetch. example: `curl -v -H "X-Admit-Token: TKN123" https://admit/api/v1/checks/TKN123`.

michael: ops note: we need backpressure and rate-limits. micro-bench can be expensive; plan quota buckets per org and a fallback policy: if quota exhausted, return PROBATION with reason "quota_throttled". doc that behavior clearly.

devops-bot: infra: micro-bench image built -> gcr.io/redwood/microbench:v20260401 digest sha256:deadbeef. Canary rollout scheduled.

faye: good. also need a small repro surface in the decision blob: `repro_cmd` (one-liner) so SEs can reproduce locally quickly. e.g. `./micro-bench --artifact 0xabc --case long --seed 11`.

omar: metrics contract: micro-bench must return per-bucket p50/p95, tokenization-diff-count, top1-stability (pct), and a tiny artifacts array with links to diffs. keep diffs gzipped.

leah: about diffing logits: rather than expensive full-matrix compare, compute a positional topK-signature hash and compare Hamming/topK-Jaccard. cheap and robust to float noise.

michael: governance: adapter-v1 and compat-shim removal timeline = 45d after announce. during that window, gateway should auto-redirect calls and emit 410 with migration link. infra will add a redirect map.

faye: on quarantine flow: tag model in registry as QUARANTINED and attach the micro-bench run id + human owner placeholder. support bulk ack and re-eval after fixes.

omar: private deployments: must support local-run mode where micro-bench returns a signed-attestation blob instead of uploading metrics. attestation schema: {run_id, decision, runner_digest, signature}. registry can later verify signature.

leah: UX: small console card showing the admit timeline (preflight -> micro-bench -> deep-bench) with single-click "rerun repro" that copies repro_cmd to clipboard and offers a run-in-debugger link.

michael: alerting: create Severity-1 if micro-bench rejection rate spikes > 3% in a day (possible rollout bug). also create slow-run alert if micro-bench median > target (target 4m).

faye: finalize: i'll draft a short OpenAPI for the three endpoints and a sample JSON decision blob. also will include a minimal state machine diagram showing transitions and backoff.

omar: i'll prototype the admit-token pattern and a tiny Redis-backed queue for token lookups.

leah: i'll write the micro-bench metric schema and the topK-signature helper lib. will add unit tests for nondet float behavior.

michael: infra + legal: coordinate enterprise migration notice and add a button in console to "request extended support" during shim window.

faye: thanks — i'll open the RFC PR with the interfaces and timeline. tagging @omar @leah @michael to review when ready. :eyes:
